claim: The Q1 of fiscal 2025 filing says Cisco recorded $0.68 in diluted EPS and $14 billion in revenue.
summary: EPS of $0.68 matches Cisco Q1 FY2025 GAAP diluted EPS, but revenue was $13.84 billion, not $14 billion, so the revenue part is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Cisco's Q1 fiscal 2025 filing recorded $0.68 in diluted EPS
sub_claims.note: From knowledge: Cisco Q1 fiscal 2025 GAAP diluted EPS was $0.68, matching the claim.

sub_claims.text: Cisco's Q1 fiscal 2025 filing recorded $14 billion in revenue
sub_claims.note: From knowledge: Cisco Q1 fiscal 2025 revenue was $13.84 billion, not $14 billion. $14 billion overstates the filed amount.
